purple.description: Elegant and creative, ideal for royal, artistic, and technical schools.

red.description: Bold and powerful, conveying energy and passion, perfect for sports and arts schools.

indigo.label: Indigo Family
indigo.description: Deep and calm, reflecting knowledge and wisdom, suited for academic and research schools.

emerald.label: Emerald Family
emerald.description: Natural and refreshing, symbolizing growth and prosperity, beautiful for community schools.

amber.label: Amber Family
amber.description: Warm and welcoming, inspiring comfort and optimism, ideal for primary schools and kindergartens.

Now you have a clearer diagnosis for each dataset and background updates without clearing the screen.
